question_set.question: Analyze the supply chain data to identify key insights about product types and customer demographics.

answer.value: The supply chain data reveals several key insights: 1) Skincare is the highest revenue product category ($241,628.16) with 40 SKUs, followed by Haircare ($174,455.39) and Cosmetics ($161,521.27). 2) Cosmetics has the highest average price ($57.36), indicating premium positioning. 3) Customer demographics show Unknown customers generate the most revenue ($173,090.13), followed by Female ($161,514.49), Male ($126,634.39), and Non-binary ($116,365.80) customers. 4) Availability averages are relatively balanced across product types (43-51%), suggesting consistent inventory management. The data highlights skincare as the primary revenue driver while cosmetics commands higher price points.

key_insights: Skincare is the highest revenue product category with $241,628.16
Cosmetics has the highest average price at $57.36
Unknown customer demographics generate the most revenue ($173,090.13)
Availability averages are consistent across product types (43-51%)
